limitations: term markers are frequency-based (rare in the source corpus): claims carried only by common vocabulary are not covered by term markers; equation/code fingerprints, destination anchors, link and lint checks provide the remaining nets

no stemming and no grammar-level matching: legitimately reworded claims are caught only through shared distinctive vocabulary; semantic verification remains a separate, human/AI evidence class (VERIFICATION_SPECIFICATION.md section 5)
equation matching compares normalized LaTeX source strings; mathematically equivalent reformatting (e.g. \frac vs \dfrac) counts as a different marker
the heading-convention check detects mixed numbered/unnumbered schemes per note; it does not validate numbering sequences or cross-note ordering
prose-quality is a word-count heuristic for bullet-only degradation; it cannot judge argument quality or depth
drift detection requires an accepted manifest; pre-acceptance changes rely on the content checks above
link findings attribute KU ownership by destination note plus wikilink presence in the excerpt, which is broader than the exact originating link
